conversations.window24Desc: You are at the edge of the reply window. From here WhatsApp starts rejecting free-form messages, and when that happens the patient receives nothing.

appointments.headerSubtitle: Load schedules from Excel, send WhatsApp reminders and see how patients replied.
appointments.uploadFileSubtitle: Schedule Excel file (.xlsx or .xls). New appointments are added, changed ones are updated and repeated ones are skipped. Loading the file doesn't send any message.
appointments.dropzoneTitle: Drag and drop the file here
appointments.noPendingReminders: Nothing to send for these dates: no appointments are loaded, or they already have a reminder, were cancelled or have no valid mobile.
appointments.errorPause: Couldn't pause: reminders are still going out. Try again or use “Stop…”.
appointments.errorResume: Couldn't resume: sending is still paused. Try again.
appointments.stopSuccess: Sending stopped. Reminders that didn't go out are still under “To send”.
appointments.errorStop: Couldn't stop: reminders may still be going out. Try again or press “Pause”.
appointments.viewSubtitle: Search, filter and export appointments, with whether the reminder was sent and how the patient replied.
appointments.viewSearchPlaceholder: Search by patient, ID, phone, doctor, specialty…
appointments.noAppointmentsFound: No appointments match the chosen search, status and dates. Try removing a filter.
appointments.rowPendingCount_one: appointment with a mobile, no reminder and not cancelled
appointments.rowPendingCount_other: appointments with a mobile, no reminder and not cancelled
appointments.reminderBandText: WhatsApp messages that remind patients of their appointment. They keep going out even if you close this screen.
appointments.progressAutoRefresh: updates by itself while the tab is open
appointments.progressPausedHint: no message goes out until you resume it. Three hours after the send started, any still waiting stop being tried and go back to “To send”.
appointments.toSendHintConfirm: by appointment date · each button asks for confirmation before sending
appointments.sendingInProgressNote: A send is in progress. When it finishes, or if you stop it, you can send again.
appointments.confirmSendText: Patients with an appointment on {{date}} who don't have it yet get a WhatsApp message. What has gone out can't be recalled; the rest can be paused or stopped.
appointments.confirmSendRemaining: There are {{total}} to send, but at most {{max}} go out each time. The other {{rest}} stay under “To send” for a second round.
appointments.confirmStopPending: The {{pending}} reminders still waiting won't go out (appointments aren't cancelled). The {{done}} already sent can't be recalled.
appointments.confirmStopGeneric: Reminders still waiting won't go out (appointments aren't cancelled). Those already sent can't be recalled.
appointments.confirmStopAfter: You can send again from this screen afterwards.
appointments.dropzoneHint: or pick it from your computer. Then press “Load appointments”.
appointments.excelColumnsTitle: Columns it reads (row 1 of the Excel file)
appointments.latestText: The {{shown}} most recent of {{total}}. To filter by date or status, open “View all appointments”.
appointments.noAppointmentsYet: No appointments loaded yet. Load the appointments file to get started.
appointments.showingLastAppointmentsRich: Showing the {{shown}} most recently loaded appointments
appointments.scopeChipTitle: To switch between General and Oncology, go back to Appointments
appointments.exportHint: Downloads every appointment matching the filter, search and dates (not just this page).
appointments.uploadingWait: This can take a few minutes: don't close this screen until it finishes.
appointments.fileTypeInvalid: The file must be Excel (.xlsx or .xls).
appointments.fileTooLarge: The file is larger than 10 MB.

uploadError.requerido: Choose the appointments file before loading it.
uploadError.tipo: The file must be Excel (.xlsx or .xls).
uploadError.tamano: The file is larger than 10 MB. Split it in two and load them separately.
uploadError.subida_incompleta: The file did not finish uploading. Try again.
uploadError.columnas_faltantes: The file is missing these columns: {{columns}}. The first row must contain the column names exactly as exported by the scheduling system. No appointments were loaded.
uploadError.fallo: The file couldn't be loaded and no appointments were saved. Check that it's the schedule Excel file and try again.

appointments.uploadResultUpdated_one: {{value}} existing appointment was updated (phone or other details changed).
appointments.uploadResultUpdated_other: {{value}} existing appointments were updated (phone or other details changed).
appointments.uploadResultMoved_one: {{value}} appointment changed date or time: it was moved, not repeated.
appointments.uploadResultMoved_other: {{value}} appointments changed date or time: they were moved, not repeated.

appointments.uploadResultSkipped_other: {{value}} were already loaded and were not repeated.

appointments.uploadResultNoDate_other: {{value}} rows without a valid date or time were not loaded.

appointments.uploadResultNoMobile_other: {{value}} appointments have no valid mobile number: they won't get a reminder.

appointments.progressSkippedHint: Already had a reminder, were cancelled or were repeated
appointments.progressRefreshFailed: Couldn't refresh progress. Sending continues on the server; retrying…
appointments.sessionExpired: Your session expired: reload the page.

appointments.warningLimit: there are {{value}} reminders to send for {{when}}, but each time you press “Send” at most {{max}} go out. The other {{rest}} will be left for a second round.
appointments.dayBeforeHint: for those who didn't get it in time
appointments.confirmSendNoMobile_one: {{value}} appointment that day has no valid mobile and won't get the message.
appointments.confirmSendNoMobile_other: {{value}} appointments that day have no valid mobile and won't get the message.

appointments.confirmResumeText_one: The reminder left in this send goes out.
appointments.confirmResumeText_other: The {{value}} reminders left in this send go out.
appointments.confirmResumeGeneric: The reminders left in this send go out.

appointments.errorAlreadyRunningAnon: A send is already in progress. You can follow it below.
appointments.errorChanged_one: The date or the number changed since you opened the confirmation: there is now {{value}} appointment on {{date}}. Check and confirm again.
appointments.errorChanged_other: The date or the number changed since you opened the confirmation: there are now {{value}} appointments on {{date}}. Check and confirm again.
appointments.errorNothingLeft: There are no reminders left to send for {{date}}.
appointments.errorNotConfigured: WhatsApp is not set up on the server: nothing was sent.
appointments.errorReload: Reload the page and try again.
appointments.errorStart: Couldn't start sending. Try again; if it keeps happening, tell IT.
appointments.errorNoAnswer: The server didn't answer. Reload the page before trying again: the send may have started.
appointments.errorNoSend: There is no send in progress anymore: it may have finished.
appointments.stopSummary: Sending stopped: {{sent}} went out; {{left}} were not sent (they stay under “To send”).
appointments.sendFinished_one: Sending finished: {{sent}} reminder went out; failed: {{failed}}.
appointments.sendFinished_other: Sending finished: {{sent}} reminders went out; failed: {{failed}}.
appointments.sendFinishedSkipped_one: {{value}} was skipped because it already had a reminder, was cancelled or was repeated.
appointments.sendFinishedSkipped_other: {{value}} were skipped because they already had a reminder, were cancelled or were repeated.
appointments.sendFinishedLeft_one: {{value}} was not sent and stays under “To send”.
appointments.sendFinishedLeft_other: {{value}} were not sent and stay under “To send”.
